title: Warm Japanese Potato Okonomiyaki
description: A savory and crumbly Japanese dish featuring potato buns and coconut cream, perfect for a crowd, this okonomiyaki is a kosher friendly delight served on a lazy susan spinner.
instructions: Preheat a large non stick skillet or okonomiyaki pan over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut cream, okonomiyaki sauce, mayonnaise, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded cabbage, chopped scallions, and bonito flakes to the bowl and mix well.
Cut the potato buns in half and hollow out the inside to make a shell.
Add the cabbage mixture to the potato buns and fill to the top.
Place the filled potato buns in the skillet and cook for 4 minutes on each side.
Serve the okonomiyaki hot on a lazy susan spinner and garnish with additional bonito flakes and scallions if desired.
Drizzle with additional okonomiyaki sauce if needed.
Let the okonomiyaki rest for a minute before serving.
